answer: Each agent boots inside a TEE‑based walnut enclave that publishes a hardware‑bound attestation signed by a trusted prism authority; the ledger records the enclave’s unique measurement as a one‑time credential and refuses any new registration that reuses the same measurement. When a node attempts a Sybil attack it must provision a distinct physical enclave, purchase a separate walnut CPU, and pay the prism authority’s attestation fee of 0.05 X‑coin per enclave, plus a 24‑hour lock‑up before the credential becomes active.
